pilot.note: Pilot agencies pay R3,999 for 2 bills, then partner wholesale R5,599 (discount measured against the wholesale price actually booked).

founding_member.monthly_plans: 30% off the first 2 monthly bills (R349 / R1,399 / R3,499); churn of 8% between bill 1 and 2 applied to the second discounted bill
founding_member.annual_plans: 2 bonus months: the annual fee (10x monthly) is recognised over 14 months instead of 12 for window cohorts, so the discount is the difference in monthly recognition over each cohort's 14-month term
founding_member.eligible: Solo and SME sign-ups only; not offered on Agency; does not stack with partner wholesale

windows.Nigeria / Kenya / Ghana: first 60 days (2 model months) after each launch

sequence: Rest of rail-covered Africa (19 countries, USD, self-serve)
markets.gated_countries: Zero revenue and customers in every scenario
markets.why: Launch months are staggered Nov 2027 / Feb 2028 / May 2028 plans behind rising MRR gates, so each country lead is hired only once SA (and the previous launch) generates enough MRR to carry it. In Base the gates, not the plan months, set the actual dates.

price_tables.repricing_policy: Reviewed quarterly; if the ZAR value of local prices has drifted more than 10%, prices are reset to ZAR parity with a one-quarter lag. Annual list escalator 6% each October in all markets.

fx_shock.definition: ZAR 15% stronger vs NGN, KES, GHS and USD from Oct 2028 (month 25), Base case

unit_economics_fy3.method: LTV = gross list ARPA x software gross margin / monthly logo churn. Solo/SME CAC = paid acquisition + shared brand, launch and marketing payroll by new-customer mix; Agencies = partner programme + partnerships team per new agency; Enterprise = inbound handling cost per deal.

conservative_diagnostics.smallest_fix_from: Conservative with Base hiring & launch gates (1.00x)

calibration_iterations.change: Previous agent's v2 draft: R25M in Feb 2027, MRR-gated hires & launches, paid cap, v1 agency sub-accounts at 40% wholesale.
calibration_iterations.result: Superseded before calibration by the partner wholesale decision.

calibration_iterations.change: Partner wholesale: agencies pay R5,599 (local/USD equivalents); separate sub-account stocks removed; Founding Member removed from Agency; CAC-payback guard added. Hiring gates identical across Base/Conservative (1.00x).
calibration_iterations.result: Base passed (min post-seed cash R7.96M) but FY5 EBITDA margin 36.7% (above the 15-30% target). Conservative failed: cash fell to -R2.56M (Sep 2029), first below buffer Dec 2028.

calibration_iterations.change: Base margin: added FY4-FY5 scale-up roles gated at R14-19M net MRR (engineers IV x5, data & AI II x3, marketing III x4, partnerships III x2, SME account managers II x4, CS agents VI x10, finance/legal/people x3, Ghana expansion x2). Raise unchanged.
calibration_iterations.result: Base FY5 EBITDA margin 27.9%; min post-seed cash R7.96M.

calibration_iterations.change: Conservative: scanned the hiring & launch gate multiplier (1.0-1.75), paid cap (20-30% of MRR) and launch delay (+3/+6/+9 months). Lower paid caps made cash worse (less acquisition); launch delay had no effect once MRR gates bind. Chose the gate multiplier.
calibration_iterations.result: Conservative gate multiplier 1.4x: min post-seed cash R4.27M (Sep 2029), profitable on seed alone: Yes. With Base gates (1.00x) it would be R-2.76M.

key_assumptions: Month 1 = Oct 2026. Opening cash R500,000 [[CONFIRM]]. Lean pre-seed mode until the R25M seed lands in Feb 2027: two founders on reduced salaries, lean hosting and overheads, pilot costs; no paid marketing or hires.

Pilot: 12 Gauteng brands free Oct-Nov 2026; 75% convert on 1 Dec 2026 at 50% off the first 2 monthly bills (R249 / R999 / R2,499 / R3,999). SA commercial launch 1 Dec 2026; no other paying customers before December.

Founding Member (option B, decided): 30% off the first 2 monthly bills (R349 / R1,399 / R3,499) for Solo and SME sign-ups inside launch windows (ZA 1 Dec 2026-31 Jan 2027; NG/KE/GH first 60 days; USD markets none); not offered on Agency. Annual plans get 2 bonus months, modelled by recognising the annual fee over 14 months for those cohorts. +20% sign-ups inside windows [[CONFIRM]].

Pricing at parity: ZAR list R499 / R1,999 / R4,999 / R7,999 / from R19,999; NG/KE/GH fixed local price points converted at 1 ZAR = ₦82.83 / KSh 8.07 / GH₵ 0.68; 19 USD markets at $27 / $109 / $269 / $429 / $1,099 at R18.50. Annual = 10x monthly, 25% of subscriptions on annual billing; +6% list escalator each October.

Partner wholesale: agency-segment customers (100%) pay R5,599 / ₦463,000 / KSh 44,999 / GH₵ 3,799 / $299 a month (Agency list -30%). Client sub-accounts are included in the partner's Agency subscription; partner referral commission is undecided and not modelled.
FX: ZAR value of local prices drifts with annual depreciation vs ZAR of NGN -10%, GHS -8%, KES -3%, USD 0% [[CONFIRM]]; quarterly repricing restores parity when drift exceeds 10% (one-quarter lag).

Segments: self-serve trials split Solo 65% / SME 35%; trial-to-paid Solo 11%, SME 14%; Solo 90% Starter / 10% Growth, upgrading 1.0%/month; SMEs 85% Growth / 15% Scale, upgrading 0.8%/month. Paid CAC Solo R2,200, SME R6,500 (+5% a year). Agencies: 0.5 inbound a month in SA plus 1.5 per partnerships manager; 0.4 per NG/KE/GH country lead. Enterprise inbound only: FY1 1 deal.
Monthly churn: Solo Starter 6.5%, Solo Growth 4.0%, SME Growth 3.0%, SME Scale 2.2%, Agency 2.0%, Enterprise 1.0% (Base; NG/KE/GH/Rest churn indices 1.05-1.25x).

Markets: ZA first; Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana launch at their planned months (Nov 2027 / Feb 2028 / May 2028) or later, when last month's net MRR clears each launch gate (R0.9M / R1.2M / R1.5M x scenario gate multiplier); Rest of rail-covered Africa (19 USD countries, self-serve, no team) from Nov 2028 behind a R2.5M MRR gate; Botswana & Namibia off; gated countries zero.

Cost discipline: every non-founder hire waits for its earliest month, the seed, and an MRR gate x scenario multiplier (Conservative 1.4x, Base 1.0x, Upside 0.8x); paid acquisition = MIN(desired, R40,000 + 35% of last month's MRR in Base) and off where CAC payback > 12 months; brand budget = MIN(ceiling, floor + 4% of MRR).

Other revenue: AI-credit top-ups (10% of workspaces buy a R350 pack monthly), WhatsApp messages resold at Meta cost +25%, R25,000 Enterprise and R4,999 agency setup fees. Commerce fee 0% in Base and Conservative, 0.75% of WhatsApp-checkout GMV in Upside only (not in current pricing). Campaign Financing excluded.

COGS: AI inference R12 per 1,000 credits falling 10% a year (40% utilisation), hosting R30k/month + R35 per workspace after the seed, 2.9% processing + 1.5% mobile-money/FX on non-SA revenue, R50 per workspace support, customer success team in COGS.
Funding & tax: R25M seed only; Series A input kept at R0 (optional acceleration). Tax 27% only once cumulative EBITDA is positive; D&A and interest ignored.
